tools.name: list_journeys
tools.description: List the user's trips (journeys) they own or have joined, with dates and whether they own it.

tools.name: get_journey
tools.description: Get one journey's itinerary: stays (the stops), flights, booked accommodations, and activities. A booked stay is ONE row that appears in both lists under the SAME id — the stop it is, and the booking it carries. Pass from_date/to_date to read one window of a long trip instead of all of it.

tools.name: create_journey
tools.description: Start a new trip. Use when the user wants a separate trip rather than adding to an existing one.

tools.name: update_journey
tools.description: Rename a trip, change its dates or description, archive it, or set its home-base countries (countries where the user has their own place — no missing-stay warnings there). Owner only.

tools.name: delete_journey
tools.description: Permanently delete a trip and everything on it — stops, flights, bookings, activities — for every member. Owner only. Irreversible; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_journey_share_link
tools.description: The link that invites someone onto a trip as a co-editor. Anyone who opens it joins immediately, so it is the whole invite — there is no separate accept step.

tools.name: list_journey_members
tools.description: Who is on a trip: user ids, roles, and profiles. Use it to get the ids that set_item_travellers takes.

tools.name: remove_journey_member
tools.description: Remove someone from a shared trip. Owner only.

tools.name: leave_journey
tools.description: Leave a trip someone else shared with the user. Owners can't leave their own trip — they delete it.

tools.name: create_stay
tools.description: Add a stay — a stop in a city — to a trip. This is how a destination gets onto the itinerary; book lodging for it with create_accommodation on the same dates.

tools.name: create_flight
tools.description: Add a flight to a trip.

tools.name: create_accommodation
tools.description: Add a booked place to stay (hotel/hostel/apartment) to a trip.

tools.name: create_activity
tools.description: Add a thing to do — or a travel leg between places — to a trip, optionally attached to a stop.

tools.name: update_stay
tools.description: Change a stop's city, country, dates or notes.

tools.name: update_flight
tools.description: Change a flight's route, times, seat, confirmation or notes.

tools.name: update_accommodation
tools.description: Change a booking's property, dates, price, confirmation or notes.

tools.name: update_activity
tools.description: Change an activity's title, timing, place or notes.

tools.name: delete_stay
tools.description: Remove a stop from the trip. Refuses when the stop carries a booking — delete the booking instead.

tools.name: delete_flight
tools.description: Remove a flight from the trip.

tools.name: delete_accommodation
tools.description: Remove a booking from the trip.

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.description: Remove an activity from the trip.

tools.name: set_item_travellers
tools.description: Say which people on a shared trip an item is for — one person's separate flight, one person's room. Omitting travelers (or passing an empty list) means everyone, which is the default and right for most items.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: Recorded spending on a trip — the money entered by hand or imported, NOT the booked prices on flights and hotels (those come back from get_journey). Includes each row's source_ref, so an importer can see what it already brought in.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Record one thing the user spent money on. Use for spend with no itinerary item of its own — meals, transport, visa fees, a booking that isn't on the trip. If the purchase IS already on the itinerary, set its price with update_flight/update_accommodation/update_activity instead; doing both counts it

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Correct a recorded expense — its amount, currency, date, title, category or which stop it belongs to.

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.description: Remove a recorded expense. Irreversible.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: The user's own spending target for a trip, if they set one. Personal, not shared: each member of a trip has their own, and no one else's is readable.

tools.name: set_budget
tools.description: Set or replace the user's own spending target for a trip. 'month' means per month of the trip; 'journey' means the whole trip. Replaces any existing target.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Who the user is: profile, the passports/nationalities they hold (which decide every visa answer), and their recorded passport documents. Worth reading before planning anything.

tools.name: get_country_info
tools.description: Country reference info and the user's visa requirement for it, based on their primary passport.

tools.name: get_visa_status
tools.description: How many days of the user's allowance in a country are used and how many remain this year — the answer to "how much longer can I stay".

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Find airports by city, name or IATA code. Use this to get the codes create_flight requires — never guess them.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find cities by name. Use it to confirm the exact city name create_stay expects.

tools.name: search_airlines
tools.description: Find airlines by name or IATA code.

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.description: Set the standing facts every trip should respect: where home is, the home airport, the currency to quote in, nightly budget, travel pace, and preferred working hours.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The user's travel documents (passports, visas, insurance, tickets) — metadata only, not the files.

tools.name: add_passport
tools.description: Record a passport from its details alone (no scan needed). Also adds the country to the user's nationalities, which is what visa answers are computed from.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete one of the user's travel documents.

tools.name: list_visas
tools.description: Visas the user holds — type, number, validity, entries used.

tools.name: create_visa
tools.description: Record a visa the user holds or has applied for.

tools.name: update_visa
tools.description: Change a recorded visa, or archive it by setting is_active to false.

tools.name: delete_visa
tools.description: Delete a recorded visa.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_documents · Private data: create_expense, get_me, list_documents, add_passport, delete_document, create_visa · Public sink: get_journey_share_link · Destructive: delete_journey, remove_journey_member, leave_journey, delete_stay, delete_flight, delete_accommodation, delete_activity, create_expense, delete_expense, delete_document, delete_visa.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_documents · Private data: create_expense, get_me, list_documents, add_passport, delete_document, create_visa · Public sink: get_journey_share_link · Destructive: delete_journey, remove_journey_member, leave_journey, delete_stay, delete_flight, delete_accommodation, delete_activity, create_expense, delete_expense, delete_document, delete_visa

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
